title: magnolia utilis
intro: Magnolia utilis, commonly known as White Bay or White Magnolia, is a species of flowering plant in the family Magnoliaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and lowering fever, making it a natural remedy for various health issues. The bioactive constituents of Magnolia utilis include magnolol, honokiol, and other volatile oils, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as sedation, antispasmodic, and antibacterial effects. Additionally, Magnolia utilis has been traditionally used to treat digestive problems, respiratory issues, and skin conditions due to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties.
